display.purpose: Hero heading only. One instance per page.

headline.purpose: Section titles (h2). Anchors each major section.

title.purpose: Card titles and experience role names.

label.purpose: Nav links, date badges, status tags. Always uppercase for navigation.

shadows.name: contact-lift
shadows.purpose: Contact cards on hover — larger vertical lift.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: Primary easing for all UI transitions. The system's motion signature.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default shorthand transition for interactive elements.

motion.name: ease-fast
motion.purpose: Quick state changes: opacity, simple color shifts.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Single breakpoint. Below: single-column, mobile nav, stacked cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Electric Blue with at-rest glow. Use for the highest-priority action on any section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; padding: 1rem 2.5rem; border-radius: 100px; background-color: #0070f3; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,112,243,0.3); transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,112,243,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0070f3; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet sibling to the primary. Transparent with ghost border. Use alongside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-block; padding: 1rem 2.5rem; border-radius: 100px; background-color: transparent; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); transition: background 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0070f3; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Standard Card
components.description: Default surface for content. Used in use-cases grid, experience timeline. Flat at rest, lifts on hover with blue border.
components.html:
Automated Reporting Pipeline

Replace manual spreadsheet work with automated data pipelines that pull, clean, and visualize your KPIs in real-time dashboards.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #111111; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 20px; padding: 2rem 2.5rem; transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #0070f3; background: rgba(17,17,17,0.7); transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 30px rgba(0,112,243,0.08); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 800; color: #ffffff; margin-bottom: 1rem; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 300; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); line-height: 1.7; }

components.name: Contact Card
components.description: Larger card for contact methods. 24px radius, 3rem padding, stronger hover lift, 'Open →' label appears on hover.
components.html:
Email

Danyjkw@hotmail.com
components.css: .ds-contact-card { position: relative; display: block; background: #111111; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 24px; padding: 3rem; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; color: #ffffff; transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); overflow: hidden; } .ds-contact-card::after { content: 'Open →'; position: absolute; bottom: 1.2rem; right: 1.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #0070f3; opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-8px); transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-contact-card:hover { transform: translateY(-10px); border-color: #0070f3; background: rgba(17,17,17,0.98); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-contact-card:hover::after { opacity: 0.8; transform: translateX(0); } .ds-contact-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; margin: 0 auto 1.5rem; background-size: contain; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: center; filter: brightness(0) invert(1); opacity: 0.8; transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-contact-card:hover .ds-contact-icon { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.2); filter: brightness(0) invert(1) drop-shadow(0 0 15px #0070f3); } .ds-contact-name { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-contact-handle { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 300; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }

components.name: Skill Tag
components.description: Floating animated tag in the About visual box. Electric Blue text, ghost border, pill radius. Pauses float animation on hover.
components.css: .ds-skill-tag { display: inline-block; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 100px; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0070f3; backdrop-filter: blur(5px); animation: ds-tag-float 3s ease-in-out infinite; transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-skill-tag:hover { background: rgba(0,112,243,0.15); border-color: #0070f3; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,112,243,0.15); animation-play-state: paused; } @keyframes ds-tag-float { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-8px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-skill-tag { animation: none; } }

components.name: Date Badge
components.description: Timeline date marker. Blue-tinted to signal temporal metadata, distinct from skill tags.
components.css: .ds-date-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 100px; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.3px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); background: rgba(0,112,243,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(0,112,243,0.25); line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Tool Card
components.description: Compact card in the Tech Stack marquee. Icon left, label right. Used in infinite-scroll rows.
components.css: .ds-tool-card { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #111111; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding: 1.5rem 2rem; border-radius: 16px; min-width: 240px; transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tool-card:hover { border-color: #0070f3; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-tool-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; margin-right: 12px; background-size: contain; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: center; filter: brightness(0) invert(1); opacity: 0.7; transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tool-card:hover .ds-tool-icon { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.2); filter: brightness(0) invert(1) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #0070f3); } .ds-tool-card span { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: Centered section title + subtitle block. Used at the top of every major section.
components.html:
Use Cases

Real solutions I build to help businesses work smarter and scale faster.
components.css: .ds-section-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 4rem; } .ds-section-title { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 3.5rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 1rem; color: #ffffff; } .ds-accent { color: #0070f3; } .ds-section-subtitle { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 300; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); max-width: 60ch; margin: 0 auto; }

narrative.overview:
Daniel Wissa's portfolio is a precision instrument in darkness. The page does not try to impress — it persuades. Every section answers the client's question before they ask it: can this person solve my problem and deliver? The layout is structured, the information hierarchical, the accent color deployed with intent. When blue appears, it means something.

The visual language is that of an engineer who thinks in systems. Dark surfaces, tight typography, confident spacing. Ambient orbs and noise texture give the darkness texture without adding noise. Nothing decorates; everything functions.

This system explicitly rejects the generic dark-sidebar portfolio template, the cheap-freelancer-site aesthetic, and the corporate HR page.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black field with a single trusted blue voice
Outfit at extreme weights (800 display, 300 body) — the contrast IS the hierarchy
Cards are surfaces that hold information, not frames around it
Hover states have authority: translate, glow, border shift
Blue fires sparingly: CTAs, active states, accent spans, hover borders only

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Electric Blue (#0070f3) occupies at most 15% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Opacity Stack Rule
rules.body: White text is always #ffffff — opacity varies by hierarchy (100% headings, 70% body, 60% supporting, 40% muted). Never substitute a gray hex.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is achieved through weight, not size alone. 800 vs 300 is the primary instrument.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Outfit only. No second typeface, no monospace exception.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Every surface is flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to user interaction.

dos: Do use #0070f3 sparingly — CTAs, active nav, hover borders, accent spans in headings.
Do use Outfit weight 800 vs 300 as the primary hierarchy tool.
Do use cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) for all UI transitions.
Do keep body text at weight 300, max 65-75ch line length.
Do shift card borders to #0070f3 on hover as the primary hover signal.
Do suppress ambient orbs and float animations under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do treat the quality of the page itself as evidence of capability.
donts: Don't build a generic dark-sidebar portfolio layout.
Don't create a cheap-freelancer aesthetic: cluttered sections, mismatched spacing, low-signal copy.
Don't use a corporate HR-page structure with rigid symmetrical columns.
Don't use animations as the main event — every motion must serve information.
Don't add a second accent color. One blue, one dark, one white.
Don't apply ambient shadows at rest.
Don't use text-align: justify on body text.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as colored accent).
Don't spread backdrop-filter to cards or page-level content elements.
